rules.discard_message: Discard the current rule changes and close this window?
rules.help: Rules: Exact replaces the full source with the target; Protect keeps the full source unchanged (leave Target blank). Built-in author-credit protection covers ◎【著】, ◎著, and common spaced forms for tw2sp, including Jieba. Do not protect bare 著: ordinary 慰藉著 must become 慰藉着. Custom example: protect 【编者】 in this book with tw2sp + Protect + Source 【编者】 + blank Target + Current book. Test it below.
